label: Namaste
description: Press palms flat together in front of the chest with fingers pointing upward; slight respectful head nod.

label: Hello
description: Open palm raised to the side of the head in a relaxed wave motion.

label: Goodbye
description: Open palm facing forward, fingers together, then wave side to side slowly.

label: Thank You
description: Flat open hand touches the chin or lips gently and moves outwards toward the conversation partner.

label: Sorry
description: Closed fist rubbed in circular motion over the chest (heart region).

label: Water
description: Make a loose cup shape with the dominant hand and tap fingertips twice gently near the side of the lips.

label: Food
description: All fingertips gathered into a pinched shape and brought repeatedly towards the open mouth.

label: Help
description: Closed dominant fist with thumb upright rests on the flat palm of the non-dominant hand; both move upward together.

label: Yes
description: Hand forms a fist and nods downward repeatedly, mimicking a head nod.

label: No
description: Index and middle fingers extended, side by side, and swept horizontally from side to side.

label: Please
description: Flat hand placed on chest and moved in a small circular motion.

label: More
description: Fingertips of both hands touch and pull apart repeatedly.

label: Stop
description: One flat hand strikes down onto the upward-facing palm of the other hand.

label: Doctor
description: Index and middle fingers of dominant hand tap the inner wrist pulse point twice.

label: Police
description: Badge shape traced with index finger on upper chest/shoulder area.

label: Hospital
description: Fingertips trace a cross (+) shape on the upper arm, like a medical symbol.

label: Emergency
description: Both hands raised palms outward, shaking rapidly to indicate distress.

label: Pain
description: Both index fingers point toward each other and move toward each other repeatedly near the painful area.

label: I / Me
description: Index finger points to self (chest).

label: You
description: Index finger extended and pointed directly toward the conversation partner.

label: Mother
description: Thumb of open hand touches the chin, fingers spread.

label: Father
description: Thumb of open hand touches the forehead, fingers spread.

label: Friend
description: Index fingers linked and unlinked alternately at chest level.

label: Teacher
description: Flat hands face each other near the temples, fingers together, then move outward.

label: Student
description: One hand holds an imaginary book while the other skims across it.

label: One
description: Index finger raised, all others closed.

label: Two
description: Index and middle fingers raised in a V-shape.

label: Three
description: Thumb, index, and middle fingers raised.

label: Four
description: Four fingers raised, thumb folded.

label: Five
description: All five fingers spread open, palm facing forward.

label: Ten
description: Thumb raised and hand shaken slightly (or both fists displayed).

label: Come
description: Index finger curls inward in a beckoning motion.

label: Go
description: Index finger points outward and arm extends in a direction.

label: Good
description: Flat hand touches the lips and moves forward and downward.

label: Bad
description: Flat hand touches the lips then flicks downward and forward sharply.
